title: Object Storage: collection order
content:
Object Storage collection order is defined as follows: Default allocation of an unspecified remittance; deterministic string.

| Contract tier | Collection order |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | collection order: invoice issue time followed by source event reference |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | collection order: invoice issue time followed by source event reference |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | collection order: invoice issue time followed by source event reference |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | collection order: invoice issue time followed by source event reference |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | collection order: invoice issue time followed by source event reference |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | collection order: invoice issue time followed by source event reference |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the collection order entry is invoice issue time followed by source event reference.
